item.title: Former Indiana Youth Minister Sentenced to 9 Years for Possessing Child Sex Abuse Material
item.description: Aaron Paul Lockman, a former youth minister, has been sentenced to nine years in prison after pleading guilty to possessing child sex abuse material.

item.title: Gwen Stefani Says Son’s Prayer Led to a Miracle Pregnancy at 44
item.description: Grammy Award-winning singer Gwen Stefani, 56, recently spoke about how her son’s prayers for a sibling inspired her to become more serious and publicly vocal about her faith in Jesus.

item.title: Greg Laurie’s Harvest Christian Fellowship Accused of Operating a ‘Cover-Up Machine,’ Hiding Abuse Allegations
item.description: A consolidated complaint alleges Greg Laurie’s Harvest Christian Fellowship hid abuse and covered up wrongdoing to protect its reputation.

item.title: ‘I Got Saved Right Then and There’—Supermodel Kathy Ireland Reveals the Moment She Met Jesus
item.description: Supermodel and brand icon Kathy Ireland shared with ChurchLeaders the powerful story of how her Christian faith began while she was modeling in Paris at 18 years old.

item.title: ‘Not a Church Plant’—Brady Boyd Launches Wednesday Worship Services in Colorado Springs
item.description: Brady Boyd, former pastor of New Life Church in Colorado Springs, announced that he and his wife are starting a Wednesday night service starting March 18.

item.title: Jets QB Justin Fields Reveals Plan To Serve as a Missionary After Football
item.description: New York Jets quarterback Justin Fields says he hopes to become a missionary after his NFL career, sharing his desire to help bring people closer to Christ.

item.title: Pastor Steve Gaines Enters Hospice Care After Cancer Battle
item.description: Pastor Steve Gaines has entered hospice care as he continues to battle cancer, Bellevue Baptist Church announced in a letter to the congregation.

item.title: ‘The Chosen’ Breaks Its Own Guinness World Record
item.description: “The Chosen” broke its own record only five months after setting a Guinness World Record as the most translated season for a streaming series.

item.title: Pastor Jamal Bryant Declares End of ‘Target Fast’ After Nearly 400 Days
item.description: Pastor Jamal Bryant announced Wednesday, March 11, that the faith-based “Target Fast” campaign he launched during Lent 2025 has ended.

item.title: 8 Questions Church Leaders Are Asking About Safely Navigating Protests
item.description: Do you have a plan at your church to safely navigate protests or other demonstrations? If not, there are steps you can take to be prepared.
